title: FreightProspecting V1 — Tier A Acceleration Campaign Phase C Gap Analysis

primary_pool.name: Tier B Worth Calling Universe (489 companies)
primary_pool.description: Companies that have 100% verified facility identity, confirmed FTL equipment fit, eligible geography, verified callable phone route, and valid evidence provenance. They currently evaluate to Tier B solely because commercial carrier use is UNKNOWN on public web surfaces.
primary_pool.conversion_opportunity: Only 81 conversions out of 489 companies (16.6% conversion rate) are required to hit the 100 Tier A goal.
primary_pool.action_strategy: Phone-first outreach to verify outside carrier usage / shipping desk procedures directly with dispatchers or shipping coordinators.

secondary_pool.name: Tier C Secondary Universe (10 companies)
secondary_pool.description: Companies with verified private fleets but unconfirmed outside carrier use. If phone outreach reveals peak-season or overflow outside carrier usage, these immediately elevate to Tier A (Private Fleet + Outside Carrier Verified).
secondary_pool.action_strategy: Inquire during dispatch calls whether outside carrier overflow is contracted during surges.

remediation_pool.name: Tier D Discovery Residual (47 companies)
remediation_pool.description: Companies with specific data gaps preventing Gate 1 qualification (e.g. WMG Technologies requiring 2026 corporate structure verification; Holiday Tree Farms seasonal/reefer boundary; Bre-Cast address/contact verification).
remediation_pool.action_strategy: Surgical primary-source desk research or state corporate filing lookups.

recommendations_for_phase_c_execution: 1. Launch Phase C focused exclusively on the 489 Tier B companies using the phone-first prospecting workflow.
2. Prioritize Tier B companies by single-facility structure and lowest broker-access friction first (LOW and UNKNOWN friction single-plant operations).

3. Enforce phone verification evidence standard: when a shipping coordinator confirms common carrier / broker pickup over the phone, record direct telephone verification evidence with contact ID and claim.
4. Track gross margin spread once freight opportunities are identified with active shippers.
5. Do NOT lower the evidence threshold or invent carrier usage claims.
